note: LRA-CUBE-ROOT (design note docs/design/LowRank-CubeRootBlockKrylov.md, cleanup). Against origin/main one merged declaration changes its statement and none is renamed or removed: NLAlib.exists_degree_lt_div_sq_le_exp_singularGapRatio is generalized from a real matrix (A : Matrix m n ℝ) to a matrix over any RCLike field (A : Matrix m n 𝕜), same conclusion (decision CHEB-GENERAL; a strengthening: every real call site is the instance 𝕜 = ℝ and is unchanged); it moves from LowRank/Gaussian/BlockKrylov to Matrix/Spectral/SingularValueInequalities (next to singularGapRatio) and is reproved from Polynomial.Chebyshev.exists_degree_lt_div_sq_le_exp_of_le; the stage's general twin exists_degree_lt_div_sq_le_exp_singularGapRatio' is merged into it (removed entry), and the private exp_div_two_le_abs_eval_T_comp of LowRank/Gaussian/BlockKrylov, a copy of Polynomial.Chebyshev.exp_mul_sqrt_div_two_le_abs_eval_T_comp, is deleted. The N6 renames below are of declarations new in this stage (never on main), listed so that the design note, the target list and the stage reports resolve: a power follows its argument (sq_singularValues -> singularValues_..._sq). Moves within the stage, no statement change: IsStarProjection.hasOrthonormalCols_two_smul_sub_one (Matrix/Norms/SchattenPinching -> Matrix/Basic/Projector), Matrix.IsHermitian.re_quadForm_cfc_eq_sum_add_sum (LowRank/Structural/RitzValues -> Matrix/Functions/HermitianCalculus), singularValues_rsvd_cfc_le_singularValues_rbki (RitzValues -> LowRank/Structural/BlockKrylov), frobNorm_sub_truncatedSVD_sq_le_min_card_mul_sq (LowRank/Gaussian/BlockKrylovSum -> Matrix/Spectral/LowRank), schattenNorm_sub_truncatedSVD_rsvd_le_mul_of_singularValues_le_mul and schattenNorm_sub_mul_rangeProjector_le_schattenNorm_sub_truncatedSVD_rsvd (LowRank/Gaussian/BlockKrylovSum -> LowRank/Structural/SingularValueDeficit); the p >= 2 tail bounds (measureReal_schattenNorm_sub_truncatedSVD_rbkiSum_gt_le_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix, its two-sided twin and its exists_forall_ form) move to the new file LowRank/Gaussian/BlockKrylovSumTail. The private frame lemma of LowRank/Gaussian/BlockKrylovSum becomes the public exists_integral_frobNorm_sub_truncatedSVD_mul_mul_pinv_sq_le_of_hasLaw_gaussianMatrix in LowRank/Gaussian/RangeFinder. Duplication audit (no statement change): the private schattenNorm_eq_zero_of_min_card_eq_zero of the tail file becomes the public NLAlib.schattenNorm_eq_zero_of_min_card_eq_zero (Matrix/Norms/Schatten, over RCLike, exponent explicit) and the private measureReal_le_add_of_ae_imp the public NLAlib.measureReal_le_add_of_ae_imp (Probability/Tail); IsStarProjection.hasOrthonormalCols_two_smul_sub_one is proved from Mathlib's IsStarProjection.two_mul_sub_one_mem_unitary; IsStarProjection.singularValues_sq_sub_specNorm_one_sub_mul_sq_le is proved by Weyl's inequality instead of min-max; the merged NLAlib.natCast_div_sub_sub_one_mul_frobNorm_sub_truncatedSVD_sq_le_card_sq_mul_singularValues_sq (LowRank/Gaussian/RangeFinder) is reproved from frobNorm_sub_truncatedSVD_sq_le_min_card_mul_sq, statement unchanged.
